caseStudy.problem: Arduino Mega sensor firmware, a Python/FastAPI telemetry backend and a React dashboard with serial and simulated transports.
caseStudy.role: Personal project: implementation, integration and testing.
architecture: Firmware emits newline-delimited JSON envelopes. Backend transport adapters normalize serial and simulator data; shared schemas and a sensor catalog connect the backend to the TypeScript dashboard.
validation: Public source includes documented focused test commands; see the repository validation notes for current results.
limitations: Hardware/software prototype with simulator support. Firmware upload, real wiring, sensor accuracy and serial reliability require physical-board acceptance. Bluetooth is a planned extension.
